description: This file defines a Java interface for services related to updating journal entry running balances in the Fineract accounting module.

classes.name: JournalEntryRunningBalanceUpdateService
classes.description: A Java interface that declares methods for updating running balances of journal entries, including an update method and a method to update the office running balance with a command input.

methods.name: updateRunningBalance
methods.description: Method intended to trigger an update of the general journal entry running balances.

methods.name: updateOfficeRunningBalance
methods.description: Method that updates the office-specific running balance based on a JsonCommand input.
